title: Day 131: Trump Declares Islamabad MOU 'Over'; US Strikes Bushehr, Chabahar, Bandar Abbas, Jask — 14 Killed in Iran; 6 US Airmen Killed in KC-135 Crash
detail: After the July 6-7 tanker attack wave, Trump declared the Islamabad Memorandum 'over,' calling Iran 'vicious, violent.' US forces conducted additional strikes near Bushehr, Chabahar, Bandar Abbas, and Jask. Iran's Health Ministry reported 14 killed and 78 injured from strikes across five provinces. Separately, six US service members were killed when a KC-135 refueling aircraft supporting operations against Iran crashed in Iraq — part of a toll that brought total US military deaths in the conflict to 14 by mid-July.

media.caption: Trump declares Islamabad MOU 'over' after tanker attacks; US bombs Sirik, Qeshm, Bandar Abbas
